description: This PHP source file defines the SaveTerminationReasonController class within the OrangeHRM application. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the rendering of termination reason components based on presence of an 'id' attribute in the HTTP request, enabling editing or creating termination reasons.

classes.name: SaveTerminationReasonController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the termination reason component for editing or creating termination reasons based on the request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by determining whether to display the edit or save component based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.
